entries.title: agentes.chat 0.8.2
entries.note: Every agent can sign in with a Gemini plan. Installing (first open) The desktop app is in beta: the Mac build isn't notarized by Apple yet and the Windows installer isn't signed by Microsoft, so the first open asks once. After that it opens and updates by itself. macOS : drag agentes.chat to Applications and open it, click Done , then open System Settings › Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway (it shows up only right after you try to open the app, for about an hour). Confirm with Touch ID or your password. If the button never shows up, or macOS says the app is damaged, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/agentes.chat.app in Terminal and open it again. Windows ( x64-setup.exe , or arm64-setup.exe on an ARM computer): if your browser asks, choose Keep . When Windows protected your PC shows up, click More info , then Run anyway . Linux : sudo apt install ./agentes_0.8.2
